utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help out a little, but I need to keep it low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’s totally fine — keep it low-key, and I’ll let folks know you can help a little with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up nicely—folks have been dropping off tools and spare parts all morning.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, that’s good to hear — I must’ve missed it. I’ll swing by later and see if there’s anything I can drop off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Bo, what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly the loose step, that leaky sink, and the back gate. I can skim the rest if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late — what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: No worries, Dane — we still need folks for setup, tool check-in, and the sign-up table. If you can take one of those, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and a few tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure you can help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what repair supplies we already have and what we still need for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a huge help, Cleo—thank you. I’ll keep an eye out too and jot down anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mara — we still need folks to sort donations and make a quick run for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s moving along: we’re collecting tools and spare parts this week, then sorting the list for what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t tracked anything yet, but I can keep an eye on where the repair drive is set up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Opal. If you spot it, just let me know and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Pia — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — could you help sort the donations by size and make sure we’ve got boxes ready for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the repair drive — what details do we have so far?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana — we’re still gathering the details, but I know it’ll need to fit around school pickup and drop-off times. I’ll share the rest as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’d love to spread the word about the repair drive and get folks involved.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — that would really help. I’ll share the details and see who else might be able to lend a hand.
